# healthchecks_project_member (Resource)

Manages project membership for an existing Healthchecks project.
## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "healthchecks_project" "example" {
  name = "Team Project"
}

resource "healthchecks_project_member" "example" {
  project_id = healthchecks_project.example.id
  email      = "teammate@example.com"
  role       = "m"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `role` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.


## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import healthchecks_project_member.example 1c580c01-499d-4832-a928-3a407d42575c/teammate@example.com
```

## Notes

- `role` should use the Healthchecks role codes supported by the instance, such as member, manager, or read-only.
- Role changes are implemented through the current web membership flow, which may remove and recreate the membership server-side.
